summary: Frontend-only verification of two scroll changes on LZR TAG static site: (1) 50vh hero pin with grey->red word wipe on headline line 2 and (2) sentence + CUSTOM (card 12) sticky-pinned group inside .custom-zone. context_for_next_testing_agent: All numeric targets from the request pass at 1440x800, 1280x720 and 390x844. Custom-zone abs top on desktop is ~7788px. To measure pin state precisely: set document.documentElement.style.scrollBehavior='auto' before window.scrollTo and wait 300-400ms. Full-bleed trigger begins as soon as .custom-zone top passes 137 (rate = 1/(0.6*vh)); scrolling +500 past the pin point already fully expands the card to viewport width.
